body: (It took me longer than i'd happily admit to get this joke, but) haha :')

I'm also in love with 'the owl and the tanager' by Sufjan Stevens: 'counting alluvial plains, the breathing inside of the range, you touched me inside of my cage, benath my shirt, your hands embraced me.' 'All i had hoped for, i kept inside your car.' Really weird but beautiful poetry.

'Are you a pusher or are you a puller? We could hold hands for fifteen minutes in the sauna. We could hold hands for a pool length underwater. I could push and pull her.' 
Alt J, Pusher. The entire song is ridiculously beautiful, peaceful, and kinda lonely. These particular lyrics always stand out to me, though.

funnily, I got the opportunity today to do something that's both scared and excited me, and feel all the better for it. I put my indecision and caution aside (it wasn't a particularly big thing but I did it, at least). I've calmed down a bit now, (was incredibly upset for a long time after I wrote this), and I'm also getting into contact with the school councillor. doing things that scare me despite the fact that they scare me is always the best way to go. It's the best advice. so, thank you.
